meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用原始人语气压缩 AI 回复,最高省 65% 输出量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 回复更简短、更省 token
copy.tagline_en: Speak caveman to slash token output by up to 65%.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want terse AI responses and lower token usage.

howto.what: 启用后，Claude回复变成极简短句，删掉客套词和冗余，技术细节、代码、错误信息仍完整保留。实测输出token减少65%。支持多个压缩强度档位。
howto.when: 当你说出“caveman mode”、“talk like caveman”等关键词，或要求“less tokens”、“be brief”，或调用/caveman命令时触发。请求提高token效率时也会自动触发。

say.text: 进入caveman模式，回答我的问题。
用caveman style，少说废话，保留代码。
say.note: 输出更简短，技术内容不变。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude replies in ultra-terse short sentences, stripping filler and fluff while keeping technical details, code, and error messages intact. Measured 65% reduction in output tokens. Multiple compression intensity levels supported.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'caveman mode', 'talk like caveman', or similar keywords, ask for 'less tokens', 'be brief', or invoke /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

say_en.text: Enter caveman mode and answer my question.
Use caveman style, fewer words, keep the code.

say_en.note: Switches to the strongest compression level.
